description: Java class defining the InterestRateChartSlab entity, including fields, relationships, and methods for creating, updating, and managing interest rate slabs and incentives within a financial application.

classes.name: InterestRateChartSlab
classes.description: Entity class representing a slab within an interest rate chart, managing interest incentives and related data.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to create a new InterestRateChartSlab instance.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the interest rate slab with data from a JsonCommand, validating the data.

methods.name: setInterestRateChart
methods.description: Associates the slab with a specific InterestRateChart.

methods.name: setOfInterestIncentives
methods.description: Returns the set of interest incentives, initializing if null.

methods.name: addInterestIncentive
methods.description: Adds an interest incentive to the slab.

methods.name: findInterestIncentive
methods.description: Finds an interest incentive by ID.

methods.name: removeInterestIncentive
methods.description: Removes an interest incentive from the slab.

methods.name: updateIncentives
methods.description: Updates incentives associated with the slab based on a JsonCommand.
